Live smoke checks after a sync: published, settings readable, hooks and the relay registered, patches.

A non-owner gets { ok: false, code: "REFUSED" }.

settings.doc: Ritual Adept: unprepared ritual spells get a Rituals group on Argon's Cast Spell panel and start with the slot unticked.
A 'Longer casts' group (casting time a minute or more) on Argon's Action-bar Cast Spell panel.
Tokens a concentration spell summoned are removed when that concentration ends.
A failed concentration save ends concentration on the roller's client; the save card shows DC and result.
Summons open with Place Summons ticked; a self-only spell's card drops leftover targets.
After Arcane Recovery is used, the owner ticks the spent slots to recover in one dialog; a D&D Beyond import's own Arcane Recovery macro is skipped for that use.
Master switch for the damage and healing riders, the damage-tray preset and Battle Medic.
Hit Dice − / + on the character sheet outside edit mode; a change re-renders open character sheets.
Scorching Ray and Magic Missile cards get one button per ray / dart (3, plus one per level above the spell's), each rolled at the creature targeted when clicked.
